candidates.name: United Parcel Service, Inc.
candidates.description: Both are global leaders in integrated express parcel delivery, logistics, and supply chain management services.
candidates.rationale: UPS directly overlaps FedEx in parcel delivery, freight, logistics, and supply-chain services for the same business shipping buyers.

candidates.name: DHL
candidates.description: Both operate extensive international networks providing air, sea, and ground express shipping solutions.
candidates.rationale: DHL directly overlaps FedEx in global parcel delivery, express shipping, freight, and logistics services for the same business shipping buyers.

candidates.name: Geopost Group
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive international parcel delivery networks and logistics solutions for e-commerce and business customers.
candidates.rationale: Geopost operates international parcel delivery and logistics networks serving businesses and e-commerce customers, directly overlapping FedEx’s core shipping services and buyers.

candidates.name: United States Postal Service
candidates.description: Both offer nationwide parcel delivery, shipping, and mail services to residential and commercial addresses.
candidates.rationale: USPS and FedEx both provide parcel shipping and delivery services to businesses and consumers for the same core logistics needs.

candidates.name: Aramex
candidates.description: Both provide global courier, freight forwarding, and logistics services with a strong focus on international shipping.
candidates.rationale: Aramex directly overlaps FedEx in international parcel delivery, courier, freight forwarding, and logistics services for the same shipping customers.

candidates.name: DB Schenker

candidates.rationale: DB Schenker overlaps FedEx in global freight transportation, logistics, and end-to-end supply-chain services for business shippers.

candidates.name: Kuehne + Nagel Group

candidates.name: C.H. Robinson

candidates.name: DSV

candidates.name: GEODIS

candidates.name: Expeditors International

candidates.name: XPO Logistics, Inc.

candidates.name: J.B. Hunt

candidates.name: Saia, Inc.

candidates.name: GLS Group
